AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 66 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7745, #7747, #7749, #7752 and #7753:

- #7745 → #7743: `audit:complete` (six SaaS text caps made surrogate-safe).
- #7747 → #6439: `audit:complete` (export design; later issue decision confirms live tool round-trips are a pre-implementation gate).
- #7749 → #2329: `audit:complete` (didit projections and signed round trips).
- #7752 → #7751: `audit:complete` (strict extra-argument rejection before file reads).
- #7753 → #5082: `audit:partial` (bounds board JSON; cold `/program` residual remains tracked on #10383; PR comment 7157445700 links the remainder).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7745-7753/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7745-7753.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 66 valid PRs audited from 70 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 180 identifiers remain, next #7757. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
